def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (keep first)
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # Fix island label variant: strip leading/trailing whitespace
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    # Fix body_mass_g: remove commas and convert to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
    # Set out-of-range body_mass_g to NaN
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = float('nan')
    return df

def answer(df):
    counts = df['island'].value_counts().to_dict()
    return counts
